metanarrative_source: HyperNorm metanarrative from established WSA authoring context. Original English biographies and calls are design proposals.

records.name: Iris Blackbar
records.biography_en: In The Domestic Watch Desk, Iris Blackbar takes the role of redaction analyst. “Leave the margins readable.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: one little black roller passing over a blank cream card with two broad bars.

records.name: Hal Patternpin
records.biography_en: In The Domestic Watch Desk, Hal Patternpin takes the role of domestic intelligence researcher. “The third dot has moved.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: palm-sized board with three large removable dots and one thick connecting cord.

records.name: Gus Quietline
records.biography_en: In The Domestic Watch Desk, Gus Quietline takes the role of observation desk officer. “I saw the curtain move.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small hand-held binoculars held away from the face.

records.name: Cobb Accessclip
records.biography_en: In The Domestic Watch Desk, Cobb Accessclip takes the role of secure records clerk. “The key is in a separate file.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: tiny smooth lock attached to a plain file case.

records.name: Nora Ruleglass
records.biography_en: In The Domestic Watch Desk, Nora Ruleglass takes the role of constitutional safeguards reviewer. “Show me the authority for that page.”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: short magnifier over a small blank rulebook with one clear colored tab.

records.name: Bert Audittrail
records.biography_en: In The Domestic Watch Desk, Bert Audittrail takes the role of internal review officer. “Who checked the checker?”
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob's field report: small wooden stamp with a sculpted loop arrow and an unmarked card.
